summary: Tennessee list marks this Morgan County tower moved; a county genealogy page shows it reassembled on a private farm near Wartburg.

facts.status_note: The Tennessee tower list marks the tower moved. The genealogy page says it was taken apart and reassembled on a farm near Wartburg.

access.note: Per TNGenWeb, the tower was reassembled on the farm of M. T. Davidson near Wartburg. The page is undated, so it does not show the tower's current condition.

events.note: State forest tower number 2-30 comes from a 1976 list of towers.

notes_for_editor: The move has no date in any fetched source, so no relocated event is recorded (events need a year). The genealogy page's photos are undated, so the story does not claim the tower stands today. The 1,832 ft elevation is the list's figure for the Oakdale entry; the list does not say whether it refers to the original site. The brief's coordinates are not checked against a source. The NHLR and FFLOS Tennessee lists (both read) do not include this tower, so no registry event is recorded.
